newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real slips 0.03 pct in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real slips 0.03 pct in listless trade.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.03 percent to close at 1.0629 per dollar in listless trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $260 million surplus on Monday.

The real fell despite dollar inflows because some players have been holding dollars to sell them on Wednesday, the last trading day of the month, in order to arbitrage with the forex futures market, dealers said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed steady at 1.0676 per greenback.
In the parallel market, the real rose 0.44 percent to close at 1.132 per dollar, traders said.
